verdict.rationale: The evidence supports bringing your own LLM provider key: the hosted plan says 'Just bring an LLM API Key', and community users describe using AnythingLLM via APIs with closed models. Nothing in the pack shows token usage tracking or cost reporting per model or per conversation. Missing for 10: token usage visibility, per-model cost tracking, per-conversation cost tracking, explicit docs on configuring provider keys or subscriptions for self-hosted instances.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, I bring my own API keys or subscriptions and can see token usage and cost per model or per conversation

citations.quote: Just bring an LLM API Key
a no-fuss way to use LLMs both locally and via APIs
choose between open-source and closed models
